title: Texas Beef Brisket
description: Texas Beef Brisket is a dish from United States prepared with beef brisket, apple cider vinegar. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Home slow-roasted brisket without a smoker; Texas smoked brisket requires smoke and temperature control.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 180 minutes.
Roast the foil-covered brisket low and slow at about 115–125°C for 7–9 hours, until probe-tender (often around 92–96°C inside); rest well before slicing. Do not use 190°C.
Let the cooked rice rest, covered, for about 50 minutes, then fluff and serve.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
